summary: Ares Sports, Media and Entertainment Opportunities LP filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering, raising ~$27.5M across four classes (Class S, I, A-S, A-I). The sales were made to accredited investors and qualified purchasers under Regulation D and Section 4(a)(2), including through a feeder vehicle for tax-exempt/non-U.S. investors. Aggregate issuance to date totals ~$769M. The filing also discloses the calculation of transactional NAV for pricing. This is a routine capital raise under a continuous offering, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or corporate event is involved.
